mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pull_task_creator_deletion (tenant_id, task_id, group_execution_id, creator_account_id, creator_identity_hash, creator_protocol_account_id, creator_phone, create_operation_id, operation_id, status, attempts, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{taskId}, #{groupExecutionId}, #{creatorAccountId}, #{creatorIdentityHash}, #{creatorProtocolAccountId}, #{creatorPhone}, #{createOperationId}, #{operationId}, #{status}, #{attempts}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pull_task_creator_deletion WHERE group_execution_id IN #{executionId}
SELECT * FROM pull_task_creator_deletion WHERE group_execution_id = #{executionId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.* FROM pull_task_creator_deletion p INNER JOIN pull_task_group_execution e ON e.id=p.group_execution_id AND e.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND e.task_id=p.task_id INNER JOIN account_creator_deletion d ON d.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND d.task_id=p.task_id AND d.group_execution_id=p.group_execution_id AND d.account_id=p.creator_account_id WHERE p.id > #{afterId} AND p.status=0 AND p.submitted_at IS NULL AND e.execution_status IN (4,5,6) AND d.lifecycle='RESERVED' AND d.operation_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT group_execution_id FROM pull_task_creator_deletion WHERE task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY group_execution_id
mapper.update: UPDATE pull_task_creator_deletion SET status = #{row.status}, attempts = #{row.attempts}, deletion_result_status = #{row.deletionResultStatus}, result_operation_id = #{row.resultOperationId}, result_identity_hash = #{row.resultIdentityHash}, evidence_json = #{row.evidenceJson}, observed_at = #{row.observedAt}, completed_at = #{row.completedAt}, reason_code = #{row.reasonCode}, reason_message = #{row.reasonMessage}, updated_at = #{row.updatedAt} WHERE id = #{row.id} AND operation_id = #{row.operationId} AND status IN (1,2,3,4)
